summary: Tested BOTH changes. CHANGE 1 (frontend, 2-ad roadmap gating): fully verified via Playwright on custom-path.tsx — REKLAMA 1/2 -> thanks ('Jeszcze jedna reklama') -> 'Obejrzyj kolejna reklame' -> REKLAMA 2/2 -> thanks -> 'Super, kontynuuj' -> roadmap generation fires only after BOTH ads. Canceling (X button) on EITHER ad-1 or ad-2 intro correctly aborts the whole flow (no roadmap created, stays on form). Regression check: single-ad flow (profile 'Wygeneruj nowe propozycje') still shows plain 'REKLAMA' (no X/Y badge) and goes straight thanks->continue (no 'next ad' button) — unaffected. CHANGE 2 (backend content length v2): new pytest suite test_iter35_shorter_intro_fields.py, 5/5 relevant tests passed (2 skipped: premium-only study-plan/daily-plan features not reachable with free test user). Measured outputs are full grammatical sentences, closely matching new shorter targets (details below), clearly ~half of iteration_34's lengths.
critical_code_review_comments: AdsProvider.tsx code is clean, well-commented, logic correctly handles the index/total loop via onNextAd; no issues found.
server.py still growing (now ~1384 lines per last iteration) — not blocking, same note as iteration_34.

success_rate.backend: 100% of applicable tests (5/5 passed, 2 skipped due to premium-only features)

seed_data_creation: Created several fresh TEST_ users for frontend (ads35*) and backend (TEST_iter35_*) flows; isolated preview data, no cleanup needed (prefixed TEST_).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Measured word counts (iteration 35, all full sentences, no fragments): profile summary = 44 words/2 sentences (target 35-45w/2s) exact match; career summary/why ranged 13-19 words/1 sentence each (target 15-20w/1s) essentially on target; career_detail.description = 33 words/2 sentences (target 30-40w/2s) on target; roadmap milestone.description ranged 17-21 words/1 sentence (target 18-25w/1s) on target; roadmap task.description (explicitly UNCHANGED this iteration) 16-18 words, consistent with prior iteration_34 baseline (~15-20w), confirming it was correctly left untouched; task_resources.overview = 29 words/2 sentences (target 30-40w/2s) slightly under but still 2 full flowing sentences, acceptable. No dash/fragment-style outputs anywhere. study_plan.summary and daily_item_resources.overview were NOT exercised (both require Premium / a generated daily-plan which the free test user and time budget didn't reach) — recommend a follow-up test with a Premium-toggled user (POST /api/premium/subscribe) to specifically verify those two fields' new ~15-20w/1s and ~18-25w/1s targets if not already covered elsewhere. Frontend ad flow: confirmed index/total badge progression, loop-back via onNextAd, dual cancel points, and no regression on single-ad call sites (watchAd default count=1).
rca_of_issue: No bugs found in either change. Both implementations match the spec exactly as described in the review request.
